payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the pretrained word embeddings used in the study, including GloVe, Edinburgh embeddings, and Emoji embeddings.

claims.text: The pretrained word embeddings used include GloVe embeddings, which are 200-dimensional and trained on 2 billion tweets.
Edinburgh embeddings were also used, which are obtained by training a skip-gram model on the Edinburgh corpus.
Emoji embeddings, learned from emoji descriptions, were utilized due to the prevalence of emojis in tweets.
